basic_profile.bio: A self-employed entrepreneur living in Long Beach, CA, who graduated with a bachelor's degree in Business Administration in 2014. Passionate about personal development and the mysteries of the subconscious mind. Enjoys late-night browsing and is always on the lookout for new business ideas and spiritual insights. In a long-term relationship and a proud pet parent. Dislikes dishonesty and negativity.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a strong foundation in business management and entrepreneurship, gained through formal education and over a decade of hands-on experience running a small business. Has a keen interest in psychology and dream interpretation, often exploring these topics through books and online courses.
